messages.body:
Hi Smita,

Thanks for your interest in the GSoC project. I recommend discussing your
proposal ideas or questions in the #gsoc
channel on the official Apache Airflow Slack. I will also share common
questions from other contributors there.

There are a lot of discussions around the project’s GitHub issue:
https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/62500, which might be helpful for
brainstorming your final approach.

Thank you again, and welcome to the community.

Best,
Jason

On Sun, Mar 29, 2026 at 10:50 PM Smita D Ambiger <smitaambiger11@gmail.com>
wrote:

> Hi Jason and Jarek,
>
> I'm Smita Ambiger, a GSoC 2026 applicant for the Breeze-Aware AI Agent
> Skills project (issue #62500).
>
> Briefly about me: I'm an Associate Software Engineer at Accenture, and I
> have 4 merged PRs in apache/burr. The most relevant is PR #656 an AST-based
> linter that required CLI introspection and structured output, which maps
> directly to the prek sync hook this project needs. I'm currently working on
> Airflow issue #63715 and have Airflow running locally with Docker.
>
> My approach:
> (1) breeze_context.py returning deterministic JSON for
> host/container/no-breeze detection,
> (2) YAML skill definitions with structured output contracts for static
> checks and unit tests,
> (3) a prek sync hook using Click introspection to auto-generate skills
> from Breeze CLI docstrings and fail CI on drift.
>
> I have confirmed 30–35 hrs/week availability during the GSoC period with
> no time off planned.
>
> I would welcome any early feedback on this approach.
>
> Thanks for your time.
>
> Smita Ambiger
> smitaambiger11@gmail.com | github.com/Smitaambiger
>
